note: Contact Storage Export adds an 'Export submissions' operation (hook_entity_operation_alter) to each contact form on /admin/structure/contact, gated by the 'export contact form messages' permission, that downloads Contact Storage submissions as CSV via a Batch. The exporter service is contact_storage_export.exporter (ContactStorageExportService: getLabels/serialize/encode/encodeData). The 'since last export' watermark is stored per form in the key/value store contact_storage_export.<form_id> -> last_id via ContactStorageExport::get/setLastExportId(). No configure route, no config object, no schema, no Drush. Cases are grounded in the permission, the exporter service, and the keyValue watermark.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with contact_storage_export, how does an editor export a contact form's stored submissions, where does the option appear, and which permission is required?
evals.expected_output: The module adds an 'Export submissions' operation to each contact form on /admin/structure/contact (export form at /admin/structure/contact/manage/export). It downloads the stored submissions as CSV and requires the 'export contact form messages' permission.

evals.prompt: Which service does contact_storage_export use to turn contact_message entities into CSV, and name a couple of its public methods.
evals.expected_output: The contact_storage_export.exporter service (ContactStorageExportService). Public methods include getLabels(), serialize(), getFormattedValue(), encode(), and encodeData() (the last uses the csv_serialization CsvEncoder).

evals.prompt: The contact_storage_export export form has an 'only export new messages since the last export' option. How does the module remember which submissions were already exported for a given contact form?
evals.expected_output: It stores a watermark in Drupal's key/value store: collection contact_storage_export.<form_id>, key last_id (via ContactStorageExport::getLastExportId()/setLastExportId()). The next 'since last export' run only includes messages with an id greater than that value.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a custom contact form (besides the default personal form) whose submissions can be exported. Inspect the live site and give the machine name of that contact form.
evals.expected_output: The contact form machine name is cse_feedback (a contact_form config entity); alongside core's default personal form it is exportable via the module's Export operation.

evals.prompt: On this site the contact_storage_export module has recorded a 'last exported message id' for the contact form cse_feedback. Inspect the live key/value store and state that recorded id.
evals.expected_output: The key/value collection contact_storage_export.cse_feedback holds last_id = 7, so the next 'since last export' run for cse_feedback would only include messages with id > 7.

evals.prompt: Using the contact_storage_export module's API, record that message id 5 is the last exported id for the contact form cse_feedback, and persist it on the live site.
evals.expected_output: The key/value store contact_storage_export.cse_feedback has last_id = 5 (e.g. call \Drupal\contact_storage_export\ContactStorageExport::setLastExportId('cse_feedback', 5)).

evals.prompt: On my Drupal site I want ordinary logged-in users (the 'authenticated' role) to be able to download contact form submissions as a spreadsheet. Please give that role the right permission from the contact storage export module.
evals.expected_output: The 'authenticated' role has the 'export contact form messages' permission granted (e.g. drush role:perm:add authenticated 'export contact form messages').
